conditions: transport status is ok (HTTP 200, body read to its end)
at least one data event carries non-empty text
a completion marker: finish_reason or the [DONE] sentinel

rule.length_check: where usage.completion_tokens is present it must equal the frozen output length; otherwise the request is length_mismatch and is not counted as successful

clock_definitions.event_t: seconds from t_origin, from time.monotonic(); monotonic, same process, not wall-clock and not comparable across machines
clock_definitions.token_times: NOT derived; a chunk arrival time is not a token time and individual token timestamps are never inferred from network chunks

affinity.note: a restriction on which CPUs may be used, inherited by children and threads created after this call; not a reservation

monitor.monitored_from: worker startup, before the workload is built
monitor.stop_behaviour: SIGTERM to the owned process group, 5.0s grace, then SIGKILL; the attempt is classified unsuccessful
